theatres.name: Lulu Global Mall, Rajajinagar
theatres.notes: Cinepolis operates both the main and VIP wings at Lulu Global Mall. The main wing (District cinema 56450) is monitored by default; add 56451 as a separate theatre entry if you want the VIP screens too.

theatres.name: Orion Mall, Dr Rajkumar Road
theatres.notes: This is PVR at Orion Mall, Dr Rajkumar Road. Do not confuse it with Cinepolis Orion Avenue Mall, Banaswadi (District cinema 925), which is a different property and is deliberately excluded.

theatres.name: Mantri Square Mall, Malleshwaram
theatres.notes: INOX Mantri Square, Malleshwaram. Not INOX Central Mantri Junction, JP Nagar (a different property).

theatres.name: GT World Mall, Magadi Road
theatres.notes: PVR GT World Mall, Magadi Road (near Prasanna Theatre).

theatres.name: Miraj Cinemas, Sunkadakatte
theatres.notes: Listed by District as "Miraj Cinemas: TGN Lotus Elite, Sunkadakatte". Single monitored property; not the Miraj screens elsewhere in Bengaluru.

theatres.name: Global Mall, Mysore Road
theatres.notes: PVR Global Mall, Mysore Road, Bengaluru. Not Lulu Global Mall.
